description: Select environment.config so Bucket can observe which buckets are deployed in an environment (EnvironmentConfig.buckets).

patches.value:
query environment($id: String!, $projectId: String) {
  environment(id: $id, projectId: $projectId) {
    canAccess
    canvasGroupRefs
    config
    configEtag
    createdAt
    deletedAt
    id
    isEphemeral
    meta {
      baseBranch
      branch
      latestSuccessfulGitHubDeploymentId
      prCommentId
      prNumber
      prRepo
      prTitle
      skippedResourceIds
    }
    name
    projectId
    unmergedChangesCount
    updatedAt
    volumeInstances(first: 200) {
      edges {
        node {
          createdAt
          currentSizeMB
          deletedAt
          environmentId
          id
          isPendingDeletion
          mountPath
          region
          serviceId
          sizeMB
          state
          volume {
            createdAt
            id
            name
            projectId
          }
          volumeId
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
